found.name: AI Essentials course
found.quote: All staff and students are automatically enrolled on this course. We recommend engaging with this course before using Generative AI.

found.name: Prompt Library
found.quote: If you want to build your confidence with using Generative AI, Library Academic and Digital Services have produced a Prompt Library.

found.name: General Guidance on the safe use of AI
found.quote: For detailed guidance on safety, see the General Guidance on the safe use of AI.

found.name: Library Academic and Digital Services
found.quote: For advice, guidance, or support on any of the Generative AI areas outlined above, please contact Library Academic and Digital Services (librarians@aber.ac.uk).
Training staff and students on general use and principles of Generative AI in their working practice

found.name: Digital Education Team training sessions
found.quote: The Digital Education Team runs regular training sessions: E-learning Essentials: Using Microsoft Copilot for Learning and Teaching Activities and E-learning Enhanced: Using the Blackboard AI Design Assistant for colleagues. You can book your place and see our other training sessions online.
